set.body: A log10 axis over a narrow range gets only power-of-ten breaks: zooming the navigation fixture's log x to [4.25, 21.35] shows a single tick, 10. A fresh compile with Coord.zoomWindows at the same window shows the same (RezoomSuite oracle), so this is break generation for transformed scales, not navigation. Acceptance: within-decade breaks (e.g. 1-2-5 or 1-3 multiples) when fewer than N decades are visible, with labels in raw units; tests on narrow and multi-decade log windows; no change to wide-range output unless intended and recorded. Evidence: scratchpad navigation-r8/log-zoom.png from Interaction 05 browser check.
set.title: [Intaglio] Log-axis breaks for narrow windows (within-decade ticks)
